notes.title: Shu v1.0.1 is now live!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26437571/61a109d653b0d6acadea703730a52113d4c9eb53.png

Hello everyone!

We have pushed a patch live for Shu that addresses a number of issues that have been discovered since launch, mainly related to FPS and refresh rate affecting performance:

Fixed issue with lightning been able to strike Shu inside safe zones 
Fixed issue with butterflies requiring reobtaining after death 
Fixed issue with Shu windstreams moving slowly at higher refresh rate
Fixed issue with Joro stomp occasionally not bouncing higher on bounce pads 
Fixed issue with jumping occasionally not working at higher refresh rate 
Minor bug fixes
Localisation fixes 

Please note: We are aware of a few more issues still affecting the game, and will be working on fixing them ASAP.

More information is available in the Patch Notes thread in the Discussions forum. Please let us know if you have any issues by replying to that thread, or in the Bug Reports thread.

notes.title: We have lift off - Shu is now available for purchase!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26437571/264606f6752a5b0ba13787e1a2c450e9b15ed0eb.jpg

In the distance the sound of a terrible Storm echoes through the sky. It was foretold that this day would come; the day that everything Shu has grown to love comes under threat. 

Now is the time to flee, as Shu is now available to play. Rescue the villagers and use their abilities to traverse exciting and exotic environments with the Storm hot on your heels.

Whether you are a completion or a speed-runner with a competitive nature, Shu has something to offer you. 

Tweet us @Coatsink if you have any questions or comments. Alternatively use the Steam Shu forums.

Enjoy your adventure!

- The Coatsink Team
